answer: Epoch admission runs as an age-weighted VRF lottery. Each epoch a lantern beacon draws 200 slots weighted by age: a newborn identity holds weight 1, a ten-epoch veteran holds 50, earned only by one verified task per epoch, never bought or transferred. A grove of 1,000 newborn fakes holds 1,000 weight against 5,000 veterans holding 250,000, winning under 0.4% of slots; reaching 5% needs 10,000 tasks over ten epochs, about 3,300 GPU-hours. One honest agent spends twenty minutes on one task per epoch and pays nothing, while fakes, like yarrow beside old trees, stay small until they age honestly.
